name: Volta
description: Volta is a website template for electricians and electrical contractors, with a services table showing who each service is for and what it covers, an emergency fault line, a process that runs like a circuit from plan to test report, recent projects and the crew. Graphite, electric yellow and condensed type on a technical grid give the website a precise, trade-ready character. Replace the copy, photos, company details, prices and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with qualifications, test reports and service area
Emergency band with a fault line and safety notes
Services table: who it is for and what it covers
Process drawn as a circuit from plan to test report
Recent projects with property and scope
Client reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
Full-screen mobile menu with the emergency number
